claims.claim: SemGuard trains a line-level semantic evaluator on SemDiff and embeds it in decoding to flag deviations, roll back to the faulty line, and regenerate, without executing code.
claims.stance_target: L4: localization plus targeted regeneration via a learned evaluator is OCCUPIED at line granularity
claims.scope_conditions: DeepSeekCoder-6.7B, QwenCoder-7B, CodeLlama-7B, StarCoder2-7B; SemDiff, MBPP, LiveCodeBench, SemDiff-Java
claims.quoted_support: Abstract: flags deviations on partial code, rolls back to the faulty line, and guides regeneration - without executing the program or requiring test cases.
numbers: semantic error rate -19.86% vs ROCODE on SemDiff

breadth.confidence_families: trained line-level semantic evaluator (not a calibrated probability)
breadth.benchmarks: SemDiff, MBPP 500 test, LiveCodeBench tasks 1 July 2024 to 1 April 2025, SemDiff-Java
breadth.label_source: line divergence between correct and incorrect implementations (SemDiff)
breadth.contamination_split: LiveCodeBench restricted to 1 July 2024 - 1 April 2025 (dataset section)
breadth.causal_intervention: rollback and regenerate at flagged line
